name: JEE Main (Joint Entrance Examination Main)

eligibility.passing_year: Class 12 passed in current or previous year

exam_pattern.negative_marking: -1 for wrong MCQ, no negative for NAT

cutoff_for_jee_advanced: Top ~2.5 lakh students qualify for JEE Advanced
preparation_tips: Focus on NCERT (Class 11 and 12) thoroughly. Practice PYQs (last 10 years). Use coaching material or quality online resources. Mock tests weekly.

name: JEE Advanced

eligibility.prerequisite: Qualify JEE Main with top 2.5 lakh rank
eligibility.age: Born on/after October 1 of year 3 years before the exam year

exam_pattern.negative_marking: Varies by question type — complex partial marking

preparation_tips: JEE Advanced requires deep conceptual clarity, not just formula memorisation. Focus on class 12 NCERT plus JEE Advanced level problem books. Solve PYQs thoroughly. Time management is critical.

important_books.Physics: IE Irodov, DC Pandey JEE Advanced

name: NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test — Undergraduate)

eligibility.education: Class 12 with PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) — minimum 50% marks (40% for SC/ST/OBC)
eligibility.age: Minimum 17 years by December 31 of year of admission

cutoff_info.private_MBBS: 400+ marks (MBBS seats available below 550 in private colleges)

preparation_tips: Focus on NCERT Biology (Class 11 and 12) very thoroughly — 80%+ questions are directly from NCERT. Physics and Chemistry need conceptual clarity. Daily revision is essential.

name: GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering)
for_admission_to: M.Tech / ME in IITs, NITs, IIITs
PSU recruitment (ONGC, BHEL, BARC, ISRO, etc.)

eligibility.education: B.Tech / BE / B.Sc Research (3rd year or final year students can also apply)

exam_pattern.subjects: 29 papers (CS, ME, CE, EE, ECE, etc.)

important_for: PSU recruitment (without written test) via GATE score. PSUs like ONGC offer ₹12–18 LPA CTC for GATE CSE/ME/EE top scorers.
preparation_tips: Focus 70% on core subject, 30% on aptitude. Attempt previous year GATE papers. Use standard textbooks (Cormen for CS, NPTEL lectures).

name: CAT (Common Admission Test)

eligibility.education: Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/PwD)

preparation_tips: CAT is about speed and accuracy. Read extensively (The Hindu editorial, books) for VARC. Practice LRDI puzzles daily. QA: brush up class 10-12 maths (Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry).

name: UPSC Civil Services Examination
full_name: Union Public Service Commission Civil Services Examination

eligibility.attempts: 6 for General, 9 for OBC, Unlimited for SC/ST (till age limit)

exam_pattern.prelims: GS Paper 1 (100Q, 200 marks) + CSAT Paper 2 (80Q, 200 marks, qualifying)
exam_pattern.mains: 9 papers — Essay, GS1-GS4, Optional (2 papers), Language

preparation_tips: Minimum 1–2 year dedicated preparation. NCERT books (Class 6–12) as foundation. Current affairs daily (The Hindu, PIB). Optional subject selection is crucial. Join test series.
